query:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.full_name, e.city, e.active_status, eva.shift
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employee_van_assignments eva ON e.employee_id = eva.employee_id
WHERE e.role = 'detailer' AND LOWER(e.city) = 'crestview'
ORDER BY e.full_name;
